title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
source: 2 source Matrix using SDB (shnid=2192) and AUD (shnid=122155)

ai_review.summary: Matrix source with some echo and sync issues, but the performance shines – a monster Scarlet > Fire pairing and stellar Let It Grow make this an under‑appreciated 1982 gem.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high energy and flawless execution of Scarlet > Fire, Let It Grow and Baby Blue, with Jerry’s vocals and guitar work highlighted as “on point.” The matrix recording captures the excitement but suffers from noticeable echo and occasional mix imbalance, leaving the technical quality mixed while the musical performance remains top‑tier.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars for its outstanding performance, while one notes significant matrix flaws; overall average rating is 4.0 with strong consensus on musical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable echo and sync issues suggest the sources are not perfectly aligned; mix sounds off to some listeners, though others describe the matrix as incredible and a fitting homage to the original.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert maintains high energy from start to finish, with a particularly powerful second‑set pairing of Scarlet > Fire and a monster Let It Grow that keeps the momentum blazing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocally on point and his guitar (Tiger) is highlighted as superb; no blown lyrics in the key songs.
